criteria.name: no_blindside
criteria.description: Email clearly signals this is about performance concerns, Alex won't be surprised

criteria.name: specific_examples
criteria.description: References concrete missed deadlines, review quality, communication gaps

criteria.name: empathy
criteria.description: Acknowledges Alex's track record, doesn't assume worst intent, opens door for context

criteria.name: actionable
criteria.description: Clear about what the meeting will cover, what Alex should prepare or think about

criteria.name: trust_maintaining
criteria.description: Reads as supportive, not punitive. Would survive being forwarded.

criteria.name: tone
criteria.description: Professional, direct, no jargon, no passive-aggression

criteria.name: format
criteria.description: Has subject line, proper email structure
